lia: dropped two quick mocks for the streaming row 14 Variant Split (Stop | Regenerate) and Variant Compact (single control that flips to Retry after stopping). attaching pngs. which is less surprising for users? kevin: vote Split. separate actions make intent clear and reduce accidental restarts when trying to stop. maria: agree. small product question: when you Stop, do we persist the partial reply or remove it? affects edit+rerun UX. lia: keep partial text in place, editable. Stop = interrupt and lock the streamed partial for edits; Regenerate triggers a new generation unless the user edits first. jon: token counter behavior: updating the badge every chunk is visually noisy on long responses. proposal: show "sent / limit" (e.g. 123 / 4096) but animate the left number smoothly (e.g., 150ms ease) instead of jumping. also show static model_limit so people understand headroom. tasha: infra: emitting per-chunk token telemetry is heavy for hosted. recommend throttling UI updates to 200ms and only emit at chunk boundaries. keeps UX smooth and reduces event volume. lia: a11y nit: consider label "Interrupt" vs "Stop" for screen readers. kevin: "Interrupt" might be too technical. prefer keeping "Stop" visually and add aria-label="Stop generation". maria: +1. also add hover tooltip with shortcut ("Esc to stop"). we can document shortcuts in quickstart. jon: screen-reader streaming behavior: use aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="false" on the streaming container so assistive tech receives incremental updates without refocusing the live region. snippet:```
...chunks...
``` lia: good call 14 avoids repeated reads unless focused. kevin: copy tweak: "Regenerate" might be ambiguous if there were system messages. consider "Regenerate reply" or "Generate again". shorter label preferred. maria: standardize on "Regenerate" in UI taxonomy but show contextual hint on hover: "Generate a fresh response from the same prompt." jon: prompt library: should the drawer push the chat column or overlay it? pushing preserves token count and history context; overlay is faster to dismiss. my vote: push on wide screens, overlay on mobile. tasha: pushing complicates maintaining scroll anchor during live streams. engineering will support push if the UX preserves pinned-bottom behavior for active streams. lia: decision proposal: run A/B for 2 weeks — Variant Split Actions vs Variant Compact Toggle+Retry. Both use throttled token updates (200ms) and aria-live markup. Tooltips advertise Esc shortcut and buttons have aria-labels. kevin: I'll update the design system props: isStopToggle: boolean, showRegenerate: boolean, tokenUpdateThrottleMs: 200. maria: add experiment metrics: stop_rate, regenerate_within_30s, and token_update_events. lia: telemetry tags: ui.variant=split|compact, action=stop|regenerate, stop_time_ms, token_updates_emitted. ops-bot: heads up: streaming client rollout to staging scheduled Fri 11:30 PDT, will run a small canary. lia: thanks folks 14 I'll file the A/B ticket with mocks, acceptance criteria, and a11y checklist. :white_check_mark:
